# Minimal JHora Tropical Position Fixture

This fixture exists only to test CSV schema handling, numeric parsing, evidence
binding, and Ayana input assembly in a clean clone. It is not a JHora export,
does not contain a screenshot or a copyrighted source extraction, and does not
certify any external astrology implementation.

The separate `test_jhora_tropical_position_transcription_external.py` suite
uses a locally supplied complete witness only when `JHORA_WITNESS_CSV` is set.
